# Ongoing - Each Player

Source: [4824](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4824); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4824-n1"></a>

- Ongoing Each Player is rising-edge triggered per player: all conditions must become true; staying true on subsequent ticks does not retrigger, and at least one must become false to rearm.

<a id="wiki-4824-n2"></a>

- Conditions are checked each server tick; with no conditions, it fires immediately whenever a player loads into the game.

<a id="wiki-4824-n3"></a>

- Team and hero/slot filters determine the associated players; Event Player is the triggering player.

Source limitations:

- Page does not describe active-rule retriggers or what changing hero/slot filters does to an executing rule.
